text: 16 year old uses for organization. My daughter uses this to organize all of her odds and ends in her bedroom closet, as well as hair accessories, blow dryer, curling wand, etc.

product_metadata.title: Honey-Can-Do 10-Pocket Over-The-Door Organizer, Natural SFT-08648 Natural
features: Hangs over the door for simple storage and easy access
Holds up to 8 pairs of shoes
Organizer coordinates with other Honey-Can-Do soft closet storage
Durable TC canvas fabric for long-term use
Cardboard stiffener in back of each panel for added support
Metal hooks secure over the door
description: No matter what you need to store behind your door, this over-the-door organizer can handle it. With both small, medium and large pockets, and with cardboard panels in each for added support, this organizer can hold anything from shoes to hats to that trendy bag you just picked up at your local boutique.
